info.title: TinyAnalytics API
info.description: The TinyAnalytics HTTP API. Read your analytics, manage sites and goals, and drive feature flags, experiments, and surveys. Every call is authenticated with an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

tags.name: sites
tags.description: Read and update a site, its tracking config, its exclusions, and its private link.

tags.name: organizations
tags.description: List the organizations you belong to and the sites inside them, and create new sites.

tags.name: overview
tags.description: Headline metrics, time series, and dimension breakdowns for a site.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Custom events, their property breakdowns, and the live event log.

tags.name: errors
tags.description: JavaScript errors captured from your site, grouped by error name.

tags.name: goals
tags.description: Define, measure, and manage conversion goals matched on a page path or event name.

tags.name: funnels
tags.description: Build and measure multi-step conversion funnels, including step drop-off.

tags.name: revenue
tags.description: Revenue totals and breakdowns from the revenue you attach to events.

tags.name: performance
tags.description: Core Web Vitals for a site, over time and broken down by dimension.

tags.name: heatmaps
tags.description: Pages with heatmap data, binned click and rage-click intensity, and cumulative scroll reach.

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: The session list and the full pageview and event timeline of one session.

tags.name: users
tags.description: The identified-user list and one user's profile, activity, and sessions.

tags.name: user-traits
tags.description: Read and write the traits attached to an identified user.

tags.name: segments
tags.description: Saved filter sets you can apply across reports.

tags.name: cohorts
tags.description: Behavioral cohorts defined by the actions visitors took.

tags.name: groups
tags.description: Group analytics — accounts, companies, or workspaces a user belongs to.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: The inventory of event names, event properties, and traits seen on a site, with their descriptions and verified marks.

tags.name: bots
tags.description: Bot and AI-crawler traffic, including the per-layer detection counts.

tags.name: alerts
tags.description: Threshold alerts that notify you when a metric moves.

tags.name: annotations
tags.description: Dated notes drawn on your dashboard charts to mark what changed.

tags.name: surveys
tags.description: In-product surveys and their responses.

tags.name: feature-flags
tags.description: Feature flags, their rollout rules, and flag evaluation for a given user.

tags.name: experiments
tags.description: A/B experiments built on feature flags, and their results.

tags.name: dashboards
tags.description: Custom dashboards and the widgets on them.

tags.name: custom-query
tags.description: Run read-only SQL against your site's analytics data.

tags.name: reports
tags.description: Scheduled email report subscriptions, including sending one on demand.

tags.name: search-console
tags.description: Google Search Console search analytics for a connected site.

tags.name: uptime-monitors
tags.description: HTTP and TCP uptime monitors and their check history.

tags.name: uptime-channels-incidents
tags.description: Uptime notification channels and the incidents raised against your monitors.

tags.name: retention-journeys
tags.description: Cohort retention curves and the page-to-page paths visitors take.

parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of filter objects, each `{ dimension, op, value }` where `value` is an array. Example: `[{"dimension":"country","op":"equals","value":["US"]}]`.

bearerAuth.description: An API key created in your account settings, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but its owner cannot access this site.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Retry after a pause.
